title: Among the patients whose creatinine level is abnormal, how many of them are
question:
Among the patients whose creatinine level is abnormal, how many of them aren't 70 yet?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: creatinine level is abnormal refers to CRE >= 1.5; aren't 70 yet refers to SUBTRACT((YEAR(CURDATE()), YEAR(Birthday))) < 70;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE l.XCL_020 IS NOT NULL
  AND l.XCL_020 NOT BETWEEN 0.6 AND 1.3
  AND (julianday('now') - julianday(p.XCL_060)) / 365.25 < 70

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.XCL_058)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.XCL_058 = T2.XCL_014
WHERE T2.XCL_024 >= 1.5
  AND (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', T1.XCL_060)) < 70
